items.summary: A voice assistant living in the Mac notch: hold fn and talk; Qwen 3.5 4B runs locally via llama.cpp with Apple's on-device speech recognition and Kokoro voice synthesis — everything works offline. Around 600 lines of patterns route everyday commands (timers, calendar, music) straight to tools without the model, answering in ~0.4s. MIT licensed; needs Apple Silicon and macOS 26+.
items.title: homie: a fully local voice buddy in your Mac's notch — hold fn, talk, and Qwen 3.5 4B runs on-device, offline (posted to Reddit, Nov 21)

items.summary: An agentic coding tool that runs local models on Apple Silicon: 12 models with 169 quantization options, a picker that recommends the best fit for your Mac's memory, and resumable downloads. Version 0.5.43 adds Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini (a 26B looped MoE with ~5B active parameters) and rebases the bundled llama.cpp on upstream v1.0.0. Apache-2.0; inference never leaves your Mac.
items.title: localcode 0.5.43: a coding agent that runs local models on your Mac, now with Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini (Show HN, Nov 22)

items.summary: A new feature for the voice assistant Incredible: hold a key, describe a job in one sentence, and it creates a dedicated agent (one for your inbox, one for invoices, each on its own schedule) that keeps working in your browser, files and connected apps — and proactively suggests work it can take over. Mac and Windows; 7-day free trial.
items.title: Incredible Agents: create a resident agent by voice — say it once and it keeps working on your computer around the clock (Product Hunt, Nov 18)
